sermon.title: Changed into Another Man
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: From 1 Samuel 10:6, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that when the Spirit of the Lord came upon Saul, God gave him another heart and turned him into another man, and that this transformation, more than prophecy or spiritual gifts, is God’s goal for every believer. He explains the new heart as a new mind, will and emotions, and illustrates it with Joshua and Caleb, Joseph, Barnabas, Esther and his own father.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: the captions read “Galatians 64” for “by whom the world is crucified unto me”; that passage is Galatians 6:14-15 (shown). His statements about Muslims, Joseph Smith, self-proclaimed prophets, psychologists, pills and recovery programs are his own and are not verified here. A few words are marked [unclear].

He says with a new heart “I don’t have to hate when I’m hated,” and God’s people don’t have to get depressed like the world does, because He gives joy that is everlasting.

faqs.question: Do Christians believe in more than one God?
faqs.answer: He says “we believe in one God and he expresses himself through the Holy Ghost through the father and through the son.”

faqs.question: What does it mean to prophesy?
faqs.answer: He says prophesy means to speak by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit, or by the inspiration of God, not your own inspiration.

faqs.question: What does “you shall be turned into another man” mean?
faqs.answer: He says “shall” means nothing can stop it from happening; turned means changed into another man.

faqs.question: How do you tell a real prophet from a false one?
faqs.answer: He says when God speaks it happens just like God said, “and that way we know a real prophet from a false one.”

faqs.question: Does it matter what you personally believe?
faqs.answer: He says “it’s not what you believe it’s what God said to believe.”

faqs.question: Do Christians have to be depressed?
faqs.answer: He says he can have joy when other people are depressed, and God’s people don’t have to get depressed like the world does.

faqs.question: What should we pray for?
faqs.answer: He asks how many pray for a new spirit and a new heart instead of always wanting what they want, and points to asking for wisdom and things that are important.

faqs.question: How many times did Saul prophesy?
faqs.answer: He says Saul prophesied twice and spoke of the mighty works of God; he didn’t give anybody any personal prophecies.

faqs.question: When does a person become “in Christ”?
faqs.answer: He says when you pray your sinner’s prayer, admit your sins, ask God to forgive you and promise to repent from them, “that’s when you become in Christ.”

faqs.question: Do you need every Christian book and TV ministry tape?
faqs.answer: He says you don’t need every book in the Bible book store or every tape from TV ministries; “there’s nothing higher than this book.”

faqs.question: What does he say about people who quit church after being mistreated?
faqs.answer: He contrasts people who get a broken heart and stay home with Joseph, who had no animosity against his brothers after they sold him.

faqs.question: Does the new heart change everything immediately?
faqs.answer: He says God gives us another heart, but it takes time for that new heart to capture our conduct and our speech, “but it’s there.”
